Webinar | June 2, 2026 Advancing Next Gen Antibodies And ADCs: From AI Driven Cell Line Development To Integrated Manufacturing Source: Cytiva Rising molecular complexity in antibody-drug conjugates is reshaping how development teams approach every stage of CMC strategy. Integrating data-driven workflows with AI-enabled tools is helping accelerate timelines while improving confidence in product quality and manufacturability. Advances in cell line development are enabling faster clone selection, boosting productivity, and revealing potential risks earlier—supporting more informed decision-making from the outset. From early process development through scale-up and commercial readiness, new approaches are aligning development and manufacturing to deliver greater consistency and efficiency. As modalities like multispecific antibodies and ADCs continue to evolve, emerging technologies focused on digital connectivity and process integration are paving the way for more predictive, streamlined bioproduction. Article | May 29, 2026 Operationalizing Immuno-Oncology Studies Source: Flourish Research Immunotherapy continues to expand what’s possible in oncology, but it also demands a new level of clinical vigilance. Managing risks like cytokine release syndrome (CRS) requires more than access to advanced infrastructure — it depends on early recognition, rapid intervention, and highly trained site teams. By combining hospital-based support with protocol-driven care, purpose-built oncology networks such as Flourish Research’s Valkyrie Clinical Trials are demonstrating how complex, high-risk studies can be safely conducted beyond traditional academic centers. Proactive monitoring, standardized escalation pathways, and continuous patient education help identify subtle warning signs before they progress, significantly reducing the need for ICU-level care. This model not only enhances patient safety but also expands access to cutting-edge therapies. Discover how integrated infrastructure and specialized expertise are reshaping where and how immunotherapy trials can succeed. access the Article! Log In Subscribe to access the full article FREE! Immunotherapy continues to expand what’s possible in oncology, but it also demands a new level of clinical vigilance. Managing risks like cytokine release syndrome (CRS) requires more than access to advanced infrastructure — it depends on early recognition, rapid intervention, and highly trained site teams. By combining hospital-based support with protocol-driven care, purpose-built oncology networks such as Flourish Research’s Valkyrie Clinical Trials are demonstrating how complex, high-risk studies can be safely conducted beyond traditional academic centers. Proactive monitoring, standardized escalation pathways, and continuous patient education help identify subtle warning signs before they progress, significantly reducing the need for ICU-level care. This model not only enhances patient safety but also expands access to cutting-edge therapies. Discover how integrated infrastructure and specialized expertise are reshaping where and how immunotherapy trials can succeed.
